# eScholarship

> UC's open access scholarly publishing platform providing institutional repositories, peer-reviewed journals, and digital scholarship discovery across the University of California system.

eScholarship is operated by the California Digital Library and serves as the primary platform for open access research dissemination across all UC campuses. It hosts institutional repositories, open access journals, preprints, and digital collections while advancing UC's commitment to making scholarship freely available.

## Core Services

- [eScholarship Repository](https://escholarship.org/repository): eScholarship Repository: institutional open access research dissemination
- [eScholarship Publishing](https://escholarship.org/publishing): eScholarship Publishing: open access journals and preprint platform

## UC Campus Collections

- [UC Davis](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucd): UC Davis institutional repository and scholarly collections
- [UC Irvine](https://escholarship.org/uc/uci): UC Irvine digital scholarship and archives collections
- [UCLA](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucla): UCLA research publications and scholarly collections
- [UC Merced](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucm): UC Merced institutional repository and research collections
- [UC Riverside](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucr): UC Riverside research articles and scholarly publications
- [UC San Diego](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsd): UC San Diego research repository and marine science collections
- [UCSF](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsf): UCSF research publications and public health scholarship
- [UC Santa Barbara](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsb): UC Santa Barbara spatial studies and scholarly articles
- [UC Santa Cruz](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsc): UC Santa Cruz institutional repository and agroecology collections
- [UC Office of the President](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucop): UC systemwide scholarly publishing and digital library infrastructure
